articles.summary: COD declared just over 53 months from FID on Phase One First long-term sales and purchase agreement (SPA) cargo lifted by Shell On October 31, 2026, Venture Global (NYSE: VG) commenced commercial operations of the first phase of its second LNG export project – Plaquemines LNG – and the sale of low-cost, U.S. LNG to the first phase’s long-term customers. The commercial operations date (COD) for Phase 1 of Plaquemines LNG was reached in just over 53 months from the final investment decision on the project, making it among the fastest greenfield LNG projects ever completed. “Achieving commercial operations at the first phase of our second LNG project in 53 months is a testament to our team's relentless dedication and hard work,” said Venture Global CEO Mike Sabel. “We are thrilled to hit another major milestone that enables us to continue delivering reliable, affordable American LNG to the global market. articles.summary: Today, Venture Global, Inc. (“Venture Global”; NYSE: VG) and China Gas Holdings Limited (“China Gas”; stock code: 0384.HK), a leading natural gas operator in China, announced the execution of an increased Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA) for the total purchase of 1.0 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) from Venture Global for twenty years starting in 2030. This agreement upsizes the previous SPA announced by the two parties in September 2026 for the purchase of 0.5 MTPA by another newly-agreed 0.5 MTPA. Venture Global’s total current long-term offtake with China Gas is now 3.0 MTPA under 20-year SPAs supplied across Venture Global’s portfolio. "Venture Global is pleased to continue growing our LNG partnership with China Gas, a leading natural gas operator in China, and help meet the country's growing energy needs with reliable, low-cost American LNG from across our Louisiana projects,” said Venture Global CEO Mike Sabel .
